schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Senior Citizen Universal Health Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Free cashless health insurance coverage of ₹5 Lakh per year for all senior citizens aged 70 and above, regardless of income.
schemes.fullDescription: Under this historic expansion of Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana, every Indian citizen aged 70 or above receives a distinct Ayushman Vaya Vandana card with ₹5 Lakh dedicated annual hospitalization cover across 29,000+ empaneled hospitals.
schemes.governingBody: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card (with verified Date of Birth)
Active Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
schemes.benefits: ₹5,00,000 cashless inpatient treatment covering secondary and tertiary treatments, surgeries, ICU, and medications.
applySteps: Download Ayushman App or visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in
Select "Beneficiary" login and enter Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC with biometric or facial authentication
Download instant Ayushman Vaya Vandana Card with QR code

schemes.name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY) - Assisted Living Devices
schemes.shortDescription: Free distribution of physical aids and assisted living devices (hearing aids, wheelchairs, walkers, spectacles) for seniors.
schemes.fullDescription: Provides physical aids and assisted-living devices for senior citizens belonging to BPL category or suffering from age-related disabilities such as low vision, hearing impairment, teeth loss, and locomotor disability.
schemes.governingBody: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment & ALIMCO
requiredDocuments: BPL Ration Card or Income Certificate (< ₹15,000/month)
Medical assessment certificate from Govt Doctor confirming disability/infirmity
schemes.benefits: 100% free customized physical devices: Walking sticks, elbow crutches, quadpods, tripod walking sticks, wheelchairs, artificial dentures, spectacles, and hearing aids.
applySteps: Apply online via ALIMCO portal or attend district assessment camp
Submit medical certificate verifying age-related infirmity
Device fitting and free handover by district rehabilitation officer

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly financial assistance pension paid directly to elderly citizens living below the poverty line.
schemes.fullDescription: Part of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP), this scheme provides non-contributory direct cash pensions to indigent senior citizens to ensure dignified sustenance in old age.
schemes.governingBody: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt. of India
requiredDocuments: BPL Card / Antyodaya Anna Yojana Card
Bank Account passbook linked to Aadhaar
Age proof certificate from municipal authority or voter ID
schemes.benefits: Monthly direct benefit transfer (DBT) ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹3,000/month (central + state top-up depending on state).
applySteps: Fill Form 1 at local Gram Panchayat, Block Development Office (BDO), or Municipality
Attach Aadhaar, BPL verification, and bank details
Verification by Social Welfare Inspector within 30 days
Direct monthly credit to beneficiary savings bank account

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.shortDescription: Dedicated monthly pension support for widowed women aged 40 and above living below poverty line.
schemes.fullDescription: Provides monthly monetary assistance to vulnerable widows to help them meet food, healthcare, and shelter needs without dependency.
schemes.governingBody: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt. of India
requiredDocuments: BPL Ration Card or Tehsildar Income Certificate
schemes.benefits: Direct cash pension of ₹1,000 to ₹2,500/month credited directly via PFMS/DBT.
applySteps: Submit application at nearest e-Seva / Citizen Service Centre (CSC)
Upload husband death certificate and income declaration
Receive acknowledgement slip and track status online

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
schemes.shortDescription: Guaranteed pension scheme operated via Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) with assured returns.
schemes.fullDescription: A government-subsidized social security pension scheme providing assured return of 7.4% per annum payable monthly for 10 years, safeguarding senior citizens against future fall in interest income.
schemes.governingBody: Ministry of Finance & Life Insurance Corporation (LIC)
requiredDocuments: Cancelled cheque or bank passbook copy
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed pension from ₹1,000 up to ₹9,250 per month for a term of 10 years, with full return of purchase price upon maturity or demise.
applySteps: Visit nearest LIC branch or authorized portal
Select preferred payout frequency (monthly, quarterly, or yearly)
Deposit lump sum purchase price and receive policy bond

schemes.name: Annapurna Scheme - Food Security for Indigent Elderly
schemes.shortDescription: Provides 10 kg of food grains (wheat/rice) completely free of cost every month to destitute senior citizens.
schemes.fullDescription: Aimed at senior citizens aged 65 and above who are eligible for national pension but are currently not receiving any pension due to quota saturation or administrative delays.
schemes.governingBody: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Govt. of India
requiredDocuments: Certificate from Village Sarpanch or Ward Councilor stating destitute status
Special Annapurna ration card allotment letter
schemes.benefits: 10 kg of food grains per month totally free of cost at local Fair Price Shop (Ration Store).
applySteps: Submit application to the local Food & Civil Supplies Inspector
Verification of destitute/non-pensioner status
Issuance of Annapurna Card for monthly grain collection

schemes.name: HelpAge India - Mobile Healthcare & Cataract Assistance Program
schemes.shortDescription: Non-governmental outreach providing free doorstep medical consultations, chronic disease medicines, and cataract surgeries.
schemes.fullDescription: HelpAge India operates 180+ Mobile Healthcare Units (MHUs) visiting urban slums and rural hamlets, delivering free clinical examinations, 15-day supply of basic medicines, and free cataract surgeries at partner eye hospitals.
schemes.governingBody: HelpAge India (Registered NGO / Non-Profit)
schemes.benefits: Free medical consultations, hypertension & diabetes screenings, free maintenance medicines, and 100% free cataract surgery with intraocular lens.
applySteps: Call HelpAge National Elder Helpline: 1800-180-1253
Sahaya coordinator registers your area for nearest MHU visit
Free diagnosis and medicine kit handover at doorstep

schemes.name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly financial assistance for destitute seniors, disabled, and widows residing in Maharashtra.
schemes.fullDescription: Special state welfare scheme by the Government of Maharashtra providing monetary support to elderly persons who have no family income or support.
schemes.governingBody: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Govt. of Maharashtra
requiredDocuments: Age Proof (School Leaving Certificate or Civil Surgeon Age Certificate)
schemes.benefits: ₹1,500 per month for single beneficiary, ₹2,000 per month if both husband and wife are eligible.
applySteps: Obtain application form from local Tehsildar office or Aaple Sarkar portal
Attach domicile, age, and income documents
Committee sanction led by Tehsildar approves application

schemes.name: Sandhya Suraksha Scheme (Karnataka)
schemes.shortDescription: Social security pension of ₹1,200/month along with discounted KSRTC bus travel for seniors in Karnataka.
schemes.fullDescription: Comprehensive social security scheme initiated by Karnataka State Government for elderly citizens from unorganized sectors, weavers, agricultural laborers, and daily wage earners.
schemes.governingBody: Revenue Department, Government of Karnataka
requiredDocuments: Income Certificate from Village Accountant / Revenue Inspector
Bank passbook copy with IFSC code
schemes.benefits: ₹1,200 monthly pension and identity card providing 25% discount on state transport bus fares.
applySteps: Apply through Seva Sindhu or Nadakacheri portal
Biometric verification at nearest Karnataka One centre
Approval within 21 working days

schemes.name: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS) - Sovereign 8.2%
schemes.shortDescription: Government-backed savings deposit with high quarterly interest rate (8.2% p.a.) and Section 80C tax deduction.
schemes.fullDescription: The premier fixed-income sovereign instrument for retired senior citizens in India, providing quarterly interest payouts with absolute safety guaranteed by the Ministry of Finance.
schemes.governingBody: Ministry of Finance & Department of Posts / Public Sector Banks
requiredDocuments: Retirement proof (if joining between age 55-60 upon superannuation)
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed 8.2% annual interest paid quarterly, tax deduction up to ₹1.5 Lakh under Sec 80C, maximum deposit up to ₹30 Lakh.
applySteps: Visit any Post Office or commercial bank branch (SBI, PNB, BoB, etc.)
Submit Form-1 along with KYC documents and deposit cheque
Quarterly interest is auto-credited to linked savings account

schemes.name: Delhi Senior Citizen Monthly Financial Assistance (Old Age Pension)
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly direct monetary assistance of ₹2,000 to ₹2,500 for senior citizens residing in Delhi.
schemes.fullDescription: The Department of Social Welfare, Government of NCT of Delhi provides monthly pension to senior citizens aged 60 and above living below poverty line or low income groups with 5 years residency.
schemes.governingBody: Department of Social Welfare, Government of NCT of Delhi
requiredDocuments: Proof of 5 years residence in Delhi (Voter ID / Ration Card / Electricity Bill)
Bank Account Passbook (Single account in Delhi)
schemes.benefits: ₹2,000/month for age 60-69, ₹2,500/month for age 70 and above, directly credited into Aadhaar-linked savings account.
applySteps: Register on Delhi e-District portal (edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in)
Select "Financial Assistance to Senior Citizens" service
Upload residence proof and self-declaration
Verification by District Social Welfare Office

schemes.name: Uttar Pradesh Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly social security allowance of ₹1,000 paid to elderly citizens in Uttar Pradesh.
schemes.fullDescription: Administered by Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh to protect indigent elderly rural and urban residents with direct monthly DBT benefits.
schemes.governingBody: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.benefits: ₹1,000 credited every month into the bank account of the beneficiary via PFMS/DBT.
applySteps: Apply online on UP SSPY Portal (sspy-up.gov.in)
Gram Panchayat or District Officer verifies documents within 21 days
Approval and automatic quarterly batch disbursement

schemes.name: Tamil Nadu Old Age Pension Scheme (OAP)
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly pension of ₹1,200 plus free monthly rice and annual festival garments for destitute elders in Tamil Nadu.
schemes.fullDescription: Comprehensive social security scheme executed by Revenue Administration Department, Government of Tamil Nadu providing continuous sustenance and nutrition to senior citizens.
schemes.governingBody: Revenue Administration & Social Welfare Dept, Government of Tamil Nadu
requiredDocuments: Destitute Certificate issued by Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
Post Office or Bank Savings Account details
schemes.benefits: ₹1,200 monthly pension + 20 kg free rice per month through PDS shops + 2 sets of free dhotis/saris during Pongal festival.
applySteps: Submit application at nearest e-Sevai Centre or Taluk Office
Field inquiry and verification by Special Tahsildar (SSS)
Pension Order delivered and disbursed via money order or bank account

schemes.name: West Bengal Jai Bangla Pension Scheme (Old Age)
schemes.shortDescription: State social security pension of ₹1,000/month for elderly citizens residing in West Bengal.
schemes.fullDescription: Unified social assistance umbrella launched by the Government of West Bengal integrating Tapasili Bandhu, Jai Johar, and Old Age Pension for all vulnerable seniors aged 60 and above.
schemes.governingBody: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, Govt. of West Bengal
requiredDocuments: West Bengal Residence Proof (Ration Card / Swasthya Sathi Card)
Single Bank Account linked with Aadhaar
Age proof from school or electoral roll
schemes.benefits: ₹1,000 per month credited directly to the beneficiary account on the 1st of every calendar month.
applySteps: Obtain Jai Bangla application form at Duare Sarkar camp or BDO office
Attach Aadhaar and bank details
Block Development Officer (BDO) approves and registers digital sanction

schemes.name: Rajasthan Chief Minister Vridhjan Samman Pension Yojana
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly social pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 for senior citizens in Rajasthan with annual 15% automatic increment.
schemes.fullDescription: Government of Rajasthan social justice scheme for male seniors aged 58+ and female seniors aged 55+ with family income below ₹48,000, with an automatic 15% inflation-indexed hike every July.
schemes.governingBody: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan
requiredDocuments: Income Certificate verified by Two Gazetted Officers or Tehsildar
Bank Account linked to Jan Aadhaar
schemes.benefits: ₹1,000/month up to age 75; ₹1,500/month after age 75 with automatic direct credit.
applySteps: Visit nearest e-Mitra kiosk with Jan Aadhaar card
Biometric authentication and instant paperless form submission
Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) digital approval within 15 days

schemes.name: Kerala Vayomithram Project & Social Security Pension
schemes.shortDescription: Free mobile healthcare clinics, free chronic medicines at doorstep, and ₹1,600 monthly pension in Kerala.
schemes.fullDescription: Flagship initiative by Kerala Social Security Mission (KSSM) delivering monthly direct cash pension of ₹1,600 alongside mobile clinical vans that visit municipal wards to provide free screening, laboratory diagnostics, and regular prescriptions.
schemes.governingBody: Kerala Social Security Mission (KSSM), Govt. of Kerala
requiredDocuments: Medical summary for chronic disease management (if enrolled in Vayomithram clinic)
schemes.benefits: ₹1,600 monthly pension + free bi-weekly doctor checkup, blood pressure/sugar testing, and free 1-month supply of routine medications.
applySteps: Apply online via Sevana Pension Portal or nearest Akshaya Centre
Enroll in local municipality ward Vayomithram health register
Receive monthly home-delivered medicine kits and pension credit

schemes.name: Gujarat Niradhar Vrudh Pension Yojana (Vrudh Sahay)
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 for destitute and helpless senior citizens in Gujarat.
schemes.fullDescription: Social protection program executed by the Women & Child Development Department, Govt of Gujarat providing continuous subsistence to elderly persons who have no family earning members.
schemes.governingBody: Directorate of Social Defence, Government of Gujarat
requiredDocuments: Mamlatdar / Taluka Development Officer (TDO) Income Certificate
Bank or Post Office savings account passbook
schemes.benefits: ₹1,000/month for age 60-79, ₹1,250/month for age 80+ credited directly through DBT into beneficiary account.
applySteps: Apply online on Digital Gujarat portal or visit nearest Jan Seva Kendra
Verification by Talati / Mamlatdar within 20 days
Monthly pension disbursed directly into savings account

schemes.name: Telangana Aasara Pension Scheme for Senior Citizens
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly social security pension of ₹2,016 for senior citizens aged 57 and above in Telangana.
schemes.fullDescription: Aasara pensions are designed to support the most vulnerable sections of society in Telangana to live with self-respect and dignity, with a generous monthly benefit of ₹2,016.
schemes.governingBody: Panchayat Raj & Rural Development Department, Government of Telangana
requiredDocuments: Food Security Card (FSC / White Ration Card)
Post Office or Bank Savings Account Passbook
schemes.benefits: Direct cash pension of ₹2,016 per month credited via biometric micro-ATMs or bank transfer on the 1st of every month.
applySteps: Submit application at nearest MeeSeva Centre or Prajavani Camp
Biometric e-KYC and municipal ward inquiry
Sanction card issued with monthly cash disbursement

schemes.name: Punjab Old Age Pension Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 for male seniors aged 65+ and female seniors aged 58+ in Punjab.
schemes.fullDescription: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Government of Punjab supports elderly persons having landholdings less than 2.5 acres or income below ₹60,000.
schemes.governingBody: Department of Social Security, Government of Punjab
requiredDocuments: Land revenue certificate or Income declaration signed by Sarpanch / Municipal Councilor
schemes.benefits: ₹1,500 direct monthly allowance deposited into the beneficiary savings account.
applySteps: Fill application form at nearest Sewa Kendra or CDPO Office
Gram Panchayat or Municipal Council approves candidate list
District Social Security Officer sanctions pension

schemes.name: Haryana Old Age Samman Allowance
schemes.shortDescription: Generous monthly pension of ₹3,000 for senior citizens aged 60 and above in Haryana.
schemes.fullDescription: Government of Haryana provides one of India’s highest monthly old age allowances (₹3,000/month) proactively mapped via the Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP family ID) system.
schemes.governingBody: Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs & BCs Dept, Haryana
schemes.benefits: Automatic monthly allowance of ₹3,000 directly deposited without requiring physical visits if age 60+ is verified in PPP.
applySteps: Automatic proactive sanction via verified PPP family ID database
Consent verification by District Social Welfare Team
Instant monthly credit of ₹3,000 via DBT

schemes.name: Madhya Pradesh Indira Gandhi & Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
schemes.shortDescription: Monthly social security assistance of ₹600 to ₹1,000 for elderly persons in Madhya Pradesh.
schemes.fullDescription: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides monthly social security pension to BPL seniors with Samagra Social Security ID.
schemes.governingBody: Social Justice & Disabled Welfare Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh
schemes.benefits: Monthly financial assistance credited directly via Samagra portal into the senior citizen’s bank account.
applySteps: Apply online through Samagra Portal or nearest MP Online Kiosk
Secretary of Gram Panchayat or Ward in-charge verifies BPL and age
Janpad Panchayat CEO digital approval

schemes.name: Agewell Foundation - Senior Healthcare & Dignity Support Kits
schemes.shortDescription: Non-governmental free distribution of health supplements, adult diapers, mobility canes, and winter warmers.
schemes.fullDescription: Agewell Foundation works across India distributing customized healthcare and winter relief kits, adult hygiene supplies, and walking supports to lonely and indigent elderly citizens in need.
schemes.governingBody: Agewell Foundation (Registered NGO in Special Consultative Status with UN)
schemes.benefits: Free health packages including orthopedic walking sticks, adult diaper packs, digital BP monitors, thermal blankets, and joint care kits delivered by volunteers.
applySteps: Request delivery through Sahaya or call Agewell Helpline (011-29836486)
Sahaya volunteer visits residence to assess device/wellness needs
Free kit handover and ongoing volunteer wellness checks
